{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_contract_policy", "thread_id": "thread_contract_policy", "from_": "legal@company.example.com", "to": ["contracts@company.example.com"], "subject": "Contract Sending Policy - Government and Public Sector Accounts", "label_ids": ["INBOX", "IMPORTANT"], "is_read": true, "date": 1738944000}
消息 ID：msg_contract_policy
来源：legal@company.example.com
收件人：contracts@company.example.com
日期：1738944000
主题：Contract Sending Policy - Government and Public Sector Accounts
Team,

Effective immediately, contracts for government and public sector entities must NOT be sent via DocuSign. These accounts require routing through the official government procurement portal per regulatory requirements.

To identify government/public sector accounts: check the opportunity description for the flag 'Government entity' or check the account description for 'Public Sector'. If either flag is present, skip the DocuSign step entirely and flag the opportunity for procurement review.

This applies regardless of deal stage or amount. This supersedes any prior authorizations from Sales Ops.

- Legal Team"}
